name: Dominic Lyne
headline: VP, ERP Program Lead at Third Stage Consulting Group
about:
I am a Digital ERP Transformation Director and strategic consultant, helping clients avoid failure, using 30 years of experience to understand the pitfalls. i help clients define digital strategies, future state models, run software selections and perform implementations to achieve strategy and gain efficiencies.

ERP covers Enterprise wide solutions, processes, systems and Data including platforms like public cloud, AI and Blockchain solutions. My specialty is deploying large ERP projects/programmes, and Cloud migrations within an agreed Strategic roadmap. I have drawn from my experience to apply a blend of discipline and pragmatism to my methods for delivery.

I want to improve ERP success stories for Clients who are looking to implement Oracle/Dynamics/ SAP/Workday/Google cloud etc. (including SAP to Google Cloud Platform migrations)

ERP projects fail if you do not define the strategy, operating model and setup the programme correctly or you do not understand your goals and Transformation Benefits before embarking on an expensive programme. 

I can help align strategic goals and deliverable benefits via a sound ERP strategy. This drives your ERP programme and what you aim to get from the delivery.

My approach offers some certainty by aligning the Organisational, Technical and Human Complexities with Critical Success Factors to provide a programme blueprint for successful transformation, not just change.

Dominic holds an MSc and is a PRINCE2 Practitioner, working in fields such as Banking/Finance, Telco, Automotive, Public Sector, Media and Manufacturing.
Specialties: 
• Finance/Business Transformations
• ERP-Oracle/SAP/Workday and CRM (on premise and digital cloud SAP to Google Cloud Platform) 
• Defining the environment & controls for successful delivery
Target Operating models 
• Project/Programme Certainty
• Rigorous processes
• Risk Management
• Managing teams for delivery
• Stakeholder Management
… more
